name: Rod Odenbach

background: Rod Odenbach is the Johnson County sheriff, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election, and the official sheriff page lists him in that office. Incoming sheriff Adrian Keeler takes office in January 2027.
